data.raw_text:
📢 TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Newfoundland and Labrador RCMP advises motorists of the potential for intermittent closures of the Trans-Canada Highway west of Clarenville in the area of the Shoal Harbour River Bridge, as crews work to recover an overturned tractor trailer.

⚠️ Motorists should plan for delays and are asked to drive with added caution and obey directions from all crews at the scene. A reminder that the Move Over Law requires all vehicles to slow down for emergency responders and move over when it is safe and practical to do so.

#nltraffic
